root_causes.description: Shipping service experiencing extreme error_rate (z>1000) and p99_latency_ms (z+701.96), propagating errors to frontend and latency to downstream quote. Topology shows frontend→shipping→quote chain; shipping failure explains both frontend errors and quote latency.

evidence.query_or_id: error_rate: window mean vs pre-incident baseline, most anomalous first - shipping z=   >1000
p99_latency_ms: window mean vs pre-incident baseline, most anomalous first - shipping z= +701.96

root_causes.description: Frontend entry point showing extreme error_rate (z>1000) and p99_latency_ms (z+657.73); symptoms of downstream shipping dependency failure rather than primary cause. Errors propagate from shipping service through the frontend.

evidence.query_or_id: error_rate: window mean vs pre-incident baseline, most anomalous first - frontend z=   >1000
p99_latency_ms: window mean vs pre-incident baseline, most anomalous first - frontend z= +657.73

root_causes.description: Quote service showing extreme p99_latency_ms (z>1000) but no corresponding error spike; latency spike caused by upstream shipping dependency failure. No error_rate anomaly observed (z≈0), consistent with dependency rather than service-internal issue.

evidence.query_or_id: p99_latency_ms: window mean vs pre-incident baseline, most anomalous first - quote z=   >1000
error_rate: window mean vs pre-incident baseline, most anomalous first - quote z= +0.00

remediation_steps: Investigate shipping service pods for crashes, OOM kills, or resource exhaustion - check kube_events and container logs for shipping deployment in otel-demo namespace
Scale or restart shipping pods if resource exhaustion confirmed; add circuit breaker at frontend level to gracefully handle shipping downstream failures
